# Appropriation Ordinance No. 02, Series of 1997

**Appropriation for Overdraft and RATA Increase**

## Summary

This ordinance appropriates P309,123.50 for overdraft in appropriation by the end of fiscal year [[1997]] and increase of Representation and Transportation Allowance (RATA) of all municipal officials of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. It also approves the revision of appropriation indicated in Supplemental Budget No. 02 prepared by the Municipal Mayor. The ordinance declares Supplemental Budget No. 02 as an integral part of the ordinance.

## Key Provisions

1.  Section I. Reversion of obligated appropriation from the Annual Budget of [[1997]] and Reversion of obligated appropriation from Supplemental Budget No. 01 of [[1997]] with the total amount of P309,788.00. The total amount of P309,123.50 is appropriated for the overdraft in appropriation by the end of Fiscal Year [[1997]] and increase of RATA of all Municipal Officials of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
2.  Section II. The Revision of Appropriation indicated in the Supplemental Budget No. 02 prepared by the Municipal Mayor is approved.
3.  Section III. The Supplemental Budget No. 02 prepared by the Municipal Mayor is made as an integral part of this Ordinance marked as "Annex A".
4.  Section IV. This Ordinance shall take effect upon approval.
5.  Section V. Adopted this 22nd day of September, [[1997]] at [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
